validation_rules: the orchestrator overwrites source_revision, target, index, build_set and every citation content_hash with the pinned values

the orchestrator runs the acceptance checks (every index unit once, part ids and roots, signal ids, unclassified units in coverage_gaps, citation freshness) inside the repair loop: a rejected answer comes back with the errors to fix
status is OK_WITH_GAPS when any unit is unclassified or coverage_gaps is non-empty; index_review alone does not make it so
